sprint_title: AstraGuard 2.4 — Week 1 Analysis Sprint Master Summary
executive_verdict: PATH A: Analysis is Good, Frozen v2 Models are Validated & Defensible.
key_takeaways: Overall 168h Forecast R² = 0.9913 across 12,000 blind test components.
96h Telemetry horizon yields 29.39% overall error reduction over 24h prediction.
Observable physical failure modes (Thermal Runaway, Electromigration, Dark Current Spikes, Spatial Outliers) achieve 95%–100% defect recall.
Physically unobservable failure modes (e.g. MEMS Stiction Onset) are isolated and routed to YELLOW (Extend Burn-in to 168h) rather than forcing an unsafe prediction.
Data leakage is strictly zero: value_168h_actual and ground-truth labels are excluded prior to feature matrix build.
